scientific_integrity.known_related_work: The 2022 orthogonal-wedge paper proves the face-count asymptotic; 2015 halfsphere paper supplies relevant Crofton methodology.
scientific_integrity.numerical_evidence: Finite quadrature and polygon simulations are corroborative rather than proof of the limit.
scientific_integrity.proof_basis: Self-contained analytic Crofton, Gaussian orthant, inverse-sine maximization and dominated convergence argument in RESULT.md.

scientific_limitations: First-order asymptotic for expected intrinsic geodesic perimeter, not an exact formula for its finite-sample distribution.
Two-dimensional unit sphere and exactly orthogonal bounding hemispheres; extensions to other angles or dimensions unproved.
No independent mathematical review and no claim of definitive historical priority.
title: Sharp perimeter deficit for spherical convex hulls in an orthogonal wedge
